adjudication.rationale: In app/models/embeddable_host.rb the `before_validation` block unconditionally calls `self.host.sub!` twice. If `host` is nil (e.g., a new record without `host` set, or bad/missing params), this will raise `NoMethodError` before validations can add an error. Additionally, Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host assigns `host.host = params[:embeddable_host][:host]` and `host.category_id = params[:embeddable_host][:category_id]` without guarding `params[:embeddable_host]`, which will also raise if that nested hash is absent. Both failure modes are directly shown in the diff and would result in 500s instead of validation errors.
